title: 🔆🔅Bandar Abbas - September 21 - Footage showing damage to the fishing boat docking area in the Posht-e Shahr district of Bandar Abbas. The US military targeted this civilian site, used for mooring fishing boats, inflicting heavy losses on the fishermen.

"SOT1, Hassan Abdolianpour – Head of the Judiciary’s Center for Attorneys of Iran (Farsi) (00:07 - 00:49): "We obtain powers of attorney from clients, and based on the powers of attorney granted to us, we initiate lawsuits—including criminal cases, the preliminary stages of which take place in county prosecutor's offices and provincial centers, then in the Tehran International Prosecutor's Office, and are subsequently referred to the Tehran Revolutionary Court. Currently, more than a hundred cases are being reviewed and processed in the Tehran Revolutionary Court before a specially designated branch. As for legal claims, we are pursuing matters in Tehran's 55th International Branch for material and moral damages and punitive damages [against the U.S.].""

"SOT2, Hassan Naghdi – Local fisherman (Farsi) (00:54 - 01:10): "It was around one o'clock in the morning when a missile hit here. Our boats were here; our boat was damaged, all our fishing nets were damaged, and our boat's engine was damaged. There were six fishing boats, and all of them were damaged.
